title: Acquirer: Carlton & United Breweries Ltd; Target: HP Bulmer (Overseas Holdings) Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Carlton and United Breweries Pty Ltd proposes to acquire HP Bulmer (Overseas Holdings) Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: Market participants expressed the opinion that alcoholic cider faced competition from ready to drink beverages and to a lesser extent beer.
body_sections.Competition analysis: A substantial lessening of competition is not predicted.
